groups.canonical_value: Require both a pool and an on-site fitness facility, with a hot tub as an additional tie-breaking preference
groups.merge_rationale: This behavior uniquely combines a required pool-and-fitness amenity pair with an optional preference for a hot tub; the hot-tub tie-breaker makes it distinct from requiring only the pair or requiring all three amenities.

groups.canonical_value: Require both a pool and an on-site fitness facility
groups.merge_rationale: This behavior requires the pool-and-fitness pair without expressing any hot-tub preference, so it is not semantically equivalent to either hot-tub-related default.

groups.canonical_value: Require a pool, a hot tub, and an on-site fitness facility
groups.merge_rationale: This behavior requires all three amenities, which is stricter than treating the hot tub as optional and distinct from requiring only a pool and fitness facility.
